formattingScope: narrow dotnet-format whitespace-only change after tests

runs.label: scalar
runs.command: PATH=/workspace/dotnet-10.0.100:$PATH DOTNET_ROOT=/workspace/dotnet-10.0.100 DOTNET_EnableHWIntrinsic=0 dotnet test tests/Meridian.Tests/Meridian.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~WriteAheadLogChecksum' --logger 'trx;LogFileName=wal-checksum-scalar.trx' --results-directory artifacts/wal-checksum-profile/test-results > artifacts/wal-checksum-profile/scalar-tests.log 2>&1

runs.label: timezone
runs.command: PATH=/workspace/dotnet-10.0.100:$PATH DOTNET_ROOT=/workspace/dotnet-10.0.100 TZ=America/New_York dotnet test tests/Meridian.Tests/Meridian.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-build --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~V2_ChecksumSurvivesTimestampTextRoundtrip' --logger 'trx;LogFileName=wal-checksum-local-time.trx' --results-directory artifacts/wal-checksum-profile/test-results > artifacts/wal-checksum-profile/local-time-tests.log 2>&1
